source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-picker-lane-fdupe-applies-too.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: The F-DUPE rule is enforced on the picker lane with its own census over the option set: a code offered twice under different uuids is cross-company ambiguous there for exactly the same reason, so it is excluded and rendered bare while its sibling is probed.
